name: dairy-data-tools
description: Skills for dairy nutritionists, vets and consultants working from a farm's own DairyComp and EZfeed exports: the DairyComp commands to export with, the herd and each pen and cow, pen cows joined to pen feed (intake, ECM per lb DM, cost per cwt, IOFC), a weekly or visit review, and a ration change with the season taken out. Read-only Python scripts, no network; results as cards.

interface.shortDescription: A farm's DairyComp and EZfeed exports, read for you
interface.longDescription: For dairy nutritionists, vets and consultants: the DairyComp commands to export a farm's records, then the herd, each pen and cow, pen cows joined to pen feed, a weekly or visit review, and a ration change with the season taken out. Read-only scripts on your computer; nothing is sent anywhere.
defaultPrompt: What's pen 21's feed efficiency and IOFC at $21.50 milk?
Get me ready for a visit: fresh cows, components, mastitis, pregnancy rate.
